Faq.title: Frequently asked
Faq.lead: If you can't find the answer here, send us a WhatsApp message.

items.q: How do I book a car?
items.a: Choose your dates and car on the website and send the booking. You get an email with your booking number right away and we confirm it. You can also book by WhatsApp or phone, 24/7.
Basic insurance, unlimited mileage, free pick-up and return at Sarajevo Airport and our office, and 24/7 roadside assistance. Full insurance with no deposit can be added for 10 € per day.

200 € for most cars and 300 € for the Audi Q7 and Mercedes E-Class. You leave it in cash at pick-up and get it back at return. You can also rent with no deposit by adding full insurance for 10 € per day.
You pay nothing in advance. The rental and extras are paid at pick-up, and the deposit is left in cash.
Yes, free of charge up to 24 hours before pick-up. A message or a call is enough.

items.q: Do you deliver to my address?
items.a: Yes. The airport and our office are free, and delivery to an address in Sarajevo costs the same as one taxi ride from the airport.

items.q: Can I drive outside Bosnia and Herzegovina?
items.a: Yes, if you arrange it with us first. Crossing the border costs 15 € once, just tick it when you book.
Yes. The whole fleet has an automatic gearbox.

items.q: What if I have an accident?
items.a: Call the police first, then us. Don't move the car until the police have made a report, we guide you from there.
